questions.question: What is the current operating state of the Air Production Unit?

stratified.air: Acute air-leak indication (rule tier, high confidence)
stratified.oil: Oil-system degradation indication (rule tier, high confidence)
stratified.both: Combined air-leak and oil-degradation indications (rule tier)
stratified.monitor: Nominal operation with deviations worth monitoring (score tier)
stratified.abstain: Not assessable from this window (telemetry gap or out-of-bank mode)

questions.question: Which subsystem does the indication involve?

stratified.air: Compressed-air production and distribution (compressor unable to build pressure against continuous demand)
stratified.both: Air system with concurrent oil-system indication
stratified.monitor: Inconclusive -- deviation without a single responsible subsystem

questions.question: On which tier, and with what confidence, is the assessment made?

stratified.score: Score tier (baseline deviation band), confidence per band

questions.question: What are the key measured values in this window?
questions.answer_source: features: tp2_p95, tp2_frac_ge9_5, mc_on_frac, lps_maxrun_min, lps_frac, oil_max, oil_elev_c, oil_trend_c (flow_mean/max where available)

questions.question: What telemetry evidence supports the assessment?
What physical mechanism explains the evidence?

stratified.air: Air escapes as fast as the compressor pumps it: the compressor runs in working duty nearly continuously (Motor_current > 4.5 A) yet TP2 never reaches the 10.2-10.5 bar load cutoff; sustained low pressure can activate the LPS warning (< 7 bar)
stratified.oil: Oil loss degrades lubrication/cooling so the oil temperature climbs above this vehicle's own healthy band (absolute thresholds do not transfer between vehicles)
stratified.monitor: Mild deviation from the vehicle baseline without a definite mechanism
stratified.healthy: Measurements sit inside the vehicle baseline band
stratified.abstain: No mechanism claim -- window not assessable

questions.question: By how much do the measurements deviate from this vehicle's baseline?
questions.answer_source: spec per_vehicle baseline stats + features (oil_elev_c, tp2 vs baseline, mc_on vs typical cycling)

questions.question: Why are alternative explanations less consistent?

stratified.air: Healthy off-load running also holds TP2 low, but at Motor_current ~4 A with full tanks; heavy service shows fill-rest cycles that reach the cutoff; the observed continuous working duty without cutoff is the leak signature
stratified.oil: Hot ambient/duty days raise oil temperature but stay within the vehicle band and lack the sustained upward trend; Oil-level polarity is epoch-specific and is not used where its healthy state is ambiguous

questions.question: Within what timeframe should action be taken?

stratified.air_rule: Immediately: the operator requires detection at least two hours before the unit becomes non-operational
stratified.oil_rule: Within the next maintenance window (24-48 h); earlier if the trend accelerates

questions.question: When within the window did the critical evidence occur?
If a failure is developing, how much lead time may remain?
questions.answer_source: evidence onset + documented mean 6.8 h anomaly lead for air leaks (Veloso 2022)

stratified.air: Air leaks in this fleet showed a mean 6.8 h anomaly lead before the maintenance event; sustained signatures leave hours, not days
stratified.oil: Oil degradation in this fleet developed over ~2-3 days before removal; the current elevation suggests days of margin at most

questions.question: When should telemetry be re-checked?
Where in the APU is the implicated subsystem?

stratified.air: Compressed-air circuit: compressor outlet, air-dryer towers, distribution to clients

questions.question: Which specific components are most suspect?

stratified.air: Distribution pipes/valves feeding clients, or the air-dryer pneumatic pilot valve and drain lines
stratified.oil: Compressor oil seals / oil circuit connections

questions.question: Which sensors carry the evidence?

stratified.air: TP2 (compressor pressure), Motor_current, LPS, DV_pressure/Towers (dryer duty)
stratified.oil: Oil_temperature (+ Oil_level where its polarity is unambiguous), Motor_current load share

questions.question: Which vehicle/unit and duty context produced this window?
Who should respond to this report?

stratified.oil_rule: Maintenance technician with planner (schedule the window)

questions.question: Who else must be informed?

stratified.rule: Fleet supervisor if removal from service is a candidate (service impact)

questions.question: Who decides removal from service?

stratified.any: Maintenance lead, per operator protocol; the report supports but does not make the decision

questions.question: What should the train operator do right now?

stratified.lps_active: Heed the low-pressure warning; the unit may become non-operational -- prepare to hand over the vehicle
stratified.no_lps: Continue operation; no driver-facing warning is active

questions.question: What action does the report recommend?

stratified.air_rule: Remove from service at the next safe opportunity and locate the leak
stratified.oil_rule: Schedule compressor oil-system inspection within 24-48 h; remove from service if the trend accelerates
stratified.monitor: Inspect at the next window; keep monitoring
stratified.abstain: No recommendation assessable -- request re-transmission / re-check telemetry

questions.question: How can the indication be verified on site?

stratified.air: Leak search on the distribution circuit (soap/gas detection), dryer drain-valve and pilot-valve check
stratified.oil: Oil level and leak inspection of the compressor oil circuit

questions.question: What is the conservative fallback if verification is inconclusive?

stratified.air: Treat as severe: remove from service (a blown client pipe in this fleet forced removal)
stratified.oil: Remove from service if oil temperature still exceeds the vehicle band at re-check

questions.question: What follow-up monitoring is required?

stratified.rule: Post-repair verification window: confirm return to the vehicle baseline band
stratified.monitor: Daily trend of the deviating quantity
